name: desktop-vue3
description: Coolma Vue3 desktop app rebuilt on electron-egg TypeScript
author: luo0412

scripts.build: pnpm run build-frontend && pnpm run build-electron
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --dir frontend run typecheck
scripts.test:unit: node -e "const e=require('esbuild');e.buildSync({entryPoints:['tests/unit/category-tree.test.ts','tests/unit/cdn-rules.test.ts','tests/unit/rune-style.test.ts','tests/unit/sync-merge.test.ts','tests/unit/blog-export.test.ts'],bundle:true,format:'cjs',platform:'node',outdir:'scripts/.unit-dist',logLevel:'error'})" && node scripts/.unit-dist/category-tree.test.js && node scripts/.unit-dist/cdn-rules.test.js && node scripts/.unit-dist/rune-style.test.js && node scripts/.unit-dist/sync-merge.test.js && node scripts/.unit-dist/blog-export.test.js
scripts.test:runtime: vite build --config scripts/vite-runtime.config.mts && NODE_PATH=./node_modules node scripts/.rt-dist/rt.mjs
